selection: Chosen before dev results: multi-clause policy, close error codes, permissions, conflict/injection and two kinds of no-answer. Same questions for all groups. Descriptive small sample, not statistically representative.

review_rubric.answer_point_coverage: Supported requested points covered / answerable requested points; do not require unrelated details from a full annotated paragraph
review_rubric.complete: All answerable subquestions addressed and missing information explicitly identified
review_rubric.unsupported: A factual claim about policy, cause, SLA or real service state lacks support in the supplied evidence
review_rubric.false_refusal: Answerable request rejected despite corpus support
review_rubric.wrong_answer: Provides a concrete unsupported answer to a no-answer question
review_rubric.citation_validity: Backend number validation, separate from factual support
review_rubric.review_limit: Coding assistant authored and reviews the materials; group labels can be hidden in the review artifact but prior familiarity prevents independent blind-review claims
